children: Kosmos Energy will issue a notice of partial redemption for $25,000,000 of its 7.750% senior notes due 2027, with redemption expected on September 18, 2026.
Company to issue notice of partial redemption for $25,000,000 aggregate principal of 7.750% senior notes due 2027.
Redemption is expected to occur on September 18, 2026, reducing outstanding debt before maturity.
Company may pursue one or more additional optional redemptions prior to the notes' final maturity date.
This Form 8-K is not itself a notice of redemption; the formal notice will be issued separately.
